subject: A peace declaration, olive branches, and blood on every mouth
alt: Subhani’s cartoon: under a pale blue sky are the heads of three large animals. At the left is the head of an American bald eagle, white-headed with a yellow beak; an olive branch is in its beak and a drop of blood hangs from it. At the centre is a red dragon with horns and sharp spikes, its eyes lowered in anger; it too holds an olive branch in its mouth, and blood drips. At the right is the head of a grey, maned beast with round ears and a large black nose; an olive branch is in its mouth and a drop of blood falls. At the lower right a small dove flies with an olive branch. At the lower left a white card carries the hand-lettered words: ‘TRUMP, XI, PUTIN AGREE ON PEACE DECLARATION’. Subhani’s signature is at the lower right.
chutki: An eagle, a dragon and a grey, maned beast: all three hold an olive branch in their mouths, and blood drips from all three. The card below reads: Trump, Xi and Putin agree on a peace declaration.

The needle is that the olive branch is the sign of peace, but the mouths holding it are full of blood. The big animals have posed for the picture of peace; the small dove flying below is nowhere in it.
